content: spatie/simple-excel 3.10.0 (packagist, wraps openspout/openspout). Stream-based xlsx/csv writer via SimpleExcelWriter::create/stream/download. Memory-efficient for large exports. league/csv 9.28.0 is a lower-level CSV-only lib (RFC 4180 compliant, stream filter support). For Laravel report CSV export, StreamedResponse + spatie/simple-excel is idiomatic; league/csv gives more control if custom encodings/escape rules needed. simple-excel handles both xlsx and csv with one API.
